title: Interactivity with gg2d3
text: Call gg2d3() ggplot, pipe result whichever interactivity verbs want. Order within chain matter — functions additive non-destructive. can use subset:
code: library(ggplot2) library(gg2d3)  p <- ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +   geom_point(size = 3)  # Full interactive stack — tooltip + hover + zoom + brush gg2d3(p) |>   d3_tooltip() |>   d3_hover() |>   d3_zoom() |>   d3_brush() # Tooltip and zoom only gg2d3(p) |> d3_tooltip() |> d3_zoom() # Brush only gg2d3(p) |> d3_brush()

title: Interactivity with gg2d3
text: d3_tooltip() shows floating tooltip containing data values user hovers visual element (point, bar, line segment, etc.). Signature: d3_tooltip(widget, fields = NULL, formatter = NULL) Tooltip behavior: fields = NULL (default), aesthetics except internal fields (starting underscore, plus PANEL, group, etc.) shown. Date datetime values automatically formatted using browser’s locale. tooltip follows cursor disappears mouse-.
code: p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, color = factor(cyl))) + geom_point()  # Default: show all mapped aesthetics gg2d3(p) |> d3_tooltip() # Show only a subset of fields gg2d3(p) |> d3_tooltip(fields = c("wt", "mpg")) # Custom JavaScript formatter # formatter receives (field, value) and returns a display string gg2d3(p) |> d3_tooltip(   formatter = "function(field, value) {     if (field === 'mpg') return field + ': ' + value + ' mpg';     return field + ': ' + value;   }" )

title: Interactivity with gg2d3
text: d3_hover() dims non-hovered elements hovered point group stands visually. Signature: d3_hover(widget, opacity = 0.3, stroke = NULL, stroke_width = NULL) Hover behavior: hovered element always opacity 1.0; opacity controls non-hovered elements . stroke stroke_width applied hovered element; stroke = NULL (default), outline added. brush selection active, hover dimming automatically disabled avoid visual conflicts. Hover resumes brush cleared.
code: p <- ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +   geom_point(size = 3)  # Default: dim others to 30% opacity; no highlight stroke gg2d3(p) |> d3_hover() # Stronger dimming gg2d3(p) |> d3_hover(opacity = 0.2) # Add a visible outline on the hovered element gg2d3(p) |> d3_hover(opacity = 0.3, stroke = "black", stroke_width = 2) # Combine with tooltip gg2d3(p) |> d3_tooltip() |> d3_hover(opacity = 0.5)

title: Interactivity with gg2d3
text: d3_zoom() enables scroll-wheel zoom drag--pan. Double-click resets original view. Signature: d3_zoom(widget, scale_extent = c(1, 8), direction = c("", "x", "y")) Zoom behavior: scale_extent[1] must >= 1 (zoom beyond original view). Axes — including temporal axes secondary axes — update dynamically zoom. Date formatting preserved. Drag--pan constrained panel background clicking data elements trigger accidental panning. Double-click resets zoom pan original view.
code: p <- ggplot(economics, aes(date, unemploy)) + geom_line()  # Default: zoom both axes, 1x minimum to 8x maximum gg2d3(p) |> d3_zoom() # Zoom x-axis only (useful for time series) gg2d3(p) |> d3_zoom(direction = "x") # Zoom y-axis only gg2d3(p) |> d3_zoom(direction = "y") # Allow up to 20x zoom gg2d3(p) |> d3_zoom(scale_extent = c(1, 20)) # x-axis only with wider zoom range gg2d3(p) |> d3_zoom(direction = "x", scale_extent = c(1, 20))

title: Interactivity with gg2d3
text: d3_brush() lets users drag define rectangular selection. Selected elements remain full opacity; unselected elements dimmed. Double-click clears selection. Signature: d3_brush(widget, direction = c("xy", "x", "y"), on_brush = NULL, fill = "#3b82f6", opacity = 0.15) Brush behavior: fill color translucent brush overlay rectangle (default "#3b82f6", light blue). opacity controls unselected elements; selected elements always opacity 1.0. on_brush receives selected data rows JavaScript array; element row object passed D3. Double-click anywhere panel clears brush restores elements full opacity.
code: p <- ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Petal.Length, color = Species)) +   geom_point(size = 2)  # Default: 2D rectangular brush, blue overlay, non-selected dims to 0.15 gg2d3(p) |> d3_brush() # Horizontal band only (select by x range) gg2d3(p) |> d3_brush(direction = "x") # Vertical band only (select by y range) gg2d3(p) |> d3_brush(direction = "y") # Custom overlay color and non-selected opacity gg2d3(p) |> d3_brush(fill = "#ef4444", opacity = 0.3) # JavaScript callback receiving selected data array gg2d3(p) |> d3_brush(   on_brush = "function(selectedData) {     console.log(selectedData.length + ' points selected');   }" ) # Combine with tooltip gg2d3(p) |> d3_tooltip() |> d3_brush()

title: Interactivity with gg2d3
text: gg2d3 integrates crosstalk package linked brushing across multiple widgets. Wrap data frame crosstalk::SharedData$new() building ggplot, give shared data widget. Brushing one widget automatically cross-highlights corresponding observations linked widgets. Crosstalk behavior: Shiny required — linked views work static HTML documents (e.g., knitted R Markdown htmltools::save_html()). SharedData group name defaults random UUID; pass group = "my_group" SharedData$new() need link widgets across separate code chunks. widget can independently carry combination d3_tooltip(), d3_hover(), d3_zoom(), d3_brush() — Crosstalk operates data key level, interactivity verb level.
code: library(crosstalk)  # Wrap dataset in SharedData — both plots share the same group shared_iris <- SharedData$new(iris)  p1 <- ggplot(shared_iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +   geom_point(size = 2)  p2 <- ggplot(shared_iris, aes(Petal.Length, Petal.Width, color = Species)) +   geom_point(size = 2)  # Each widget gets its own brush; brushing either highlights both w1 <- gg2d3(p1) |> d3_tooltip() |> d3_brush() w2 <- gg2d3(p2) |> d3_tooltip() |> d3_brush()  # Display side by side in R Markdown or Shiny htmltools::browsable(htmltools::tagList(w1, w2))

title: Interactivity with gg2d3
text: Brush overrides hover — brush selection active, hover dimming suspended. Hover resumes soon brush cleared (double-click). Zoom brush coexist — zooming clear existing brush selection; selection rectangle scales view. Large datasets — datasets ~10 k rows, prefer d3_tooltip() d3_hover(). Tooltip hit-testing O(1) per element; hover dimming iterates elements every mouse event. Faceted plots — brush selection per-panel. Selecting one facet dim elements facets; use Crosstalk cross-panel linking. Zoom extent — scale_extent[1] must >= 1. Setting 1 allow zooming original view, distorts axis labels; function raises error instead.

title: Getting started with gg2d3
text: widget size defaults viewer/container size. Override width height (pixels CSS units):
code: library(ggplot2) library(gg2d3)  p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +   geom_point() +   ggtitle("Motor Trend Cars")  gg2d3(p) gg2d3(p, width = 800, height = 500)

title: Getting started with gg2d3
text: gg2d3 supports 15 geom types. aesthetics ggplot2 maps (color, fill, size, shape, alpha, linewidth) carried D3.

title: Getting started with gg2d3
code: # Scatter plot (ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +   geom_point(size = 3)) |>   gg2d3() # Line chart (connects points in x order) (ggplot(economics, aes(date, unemploy)) +   geom_line()) |>   gg2d3() # Path (connects points in data order) (ggplot(data.frame(x = cos(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 60)),                     y = sin(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 60))),         aes(x, y)) +   geom_path() +   coord_fixed()) |>   gg2d3()

title: Getting started with gg2d3
text: geoms pre-computed R (via ggplot2’s stat system) rendered D3. JavaScript statistics needed.
code: # Boxplot (ggplot(mpg, aes(class, hwy)) +   geom_boxplot()) |>   gg2d3() # Violin (ggplot(mpg, aes(class, hwy, fill = class)) +   geom_violin()) |>   gg2d3() # Density (ggplot(diamonds, aes(price, fill = cut)) +   geom_density(alpha = 0.5)) |>   gg2d3() # Smooth (loess or lm) (ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy)) +   geom_point() +   geom_smooth(method = "loess")) |>   gg2d3() #> `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

text: Log, sqrt, reverse transforms work expected:
code: (ggplot(diamonds, aes(carat, price)) +   geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +   scale_y_log10()) |>   gg2d3()

title: Getting started with gg2d3
text: Date POSIXct columns automatically detected rendered temporal D3 scales. Axis tick labels use format ggplot2’s date_labels argument: POSIXct (datetime) works way: Timezone information scale_x_datetime(timezone = ...) preserved tooltips.
code: df <- data.frame(   date = seq(as.Date("2024-01-01"), as.Date("2024-12-31"), by = "month"),   value = cumsum(rnorm(12)) )  (ggplot(df, aes(date, value)) +   geom_line() +   geom_point() +   scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y")) |>   gg2d3() df <- data.frame(   time = as.POSIXct("2024-01-01") + (0:23) * 3600,   temp = 15 + 5 * sin(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 24)) + rnorm(24, sd = 0.5) )  (ggplot(df, aes(time, temp)) +   geom_line() +   scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%H:%M")) |>   gg2d3()

title: Getting started with gg2d3
text: Secondary axes fully rendered — ticks, labels, axis title sec_axis() appear opposite side panel.
code: # Secondary axis showing unemployment in millions (ggplot(economics, aes(date, unemploy)) +   geom_line() +   scale_y_continuous(     name = "Unemployment (thousands)",     sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / 1000, name = "Millions")   )) |>   gg2d3()

title: Getting started with gg2d3
text: Continuous color fill aesthetics render true colorbar legend (gradient axis ticks), stack discrete keys. Discrete palettes — viridis, brewer, manual — produce identical hex codes ggplot2’s output.
code: # Viridis continuous → colorbar legend (ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +   geom_tile() +   scale_fill_viridis_c()) |>   gg2d3() # Brewer discrete (ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, color = class)) +   geom_point() +   scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2")) |>   gg2d3() # Manual (ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +   geom_point(size = 3) +   scale_color_manual(values = c("4" = "#1b9e77", "6" = "#d95f02", "8" = "#7570b3"))) |>   gg2d3()

title: Getting started with gg2d3
text: realistic example combining multiple features:
code: # warning = FALSE: loess emits "neighborhood too small" / "pseudoinverse" # notes when fit per (class × year) — some classes have <4 points per # facet. The fit still renders; the messages are expected for this demo. (ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, color = class)) +   geom_point(size = 2) +   geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE) +   facet_wrap(~year) +   scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +   labs(     title = "Engine displacement vs highway MPG",     subtitle = "By vehicle class and model year",     x = "Displacement (L)",     y = "Highway MPG"   ) +   theme_minimal()) |>   gg2d3() |>   d3_tooltip() |>   d3_hover() |>   d3_zoom()

title: Getting started with gg2d3
text: gg2d3 provides three observable guarantees data geoms fall outside normal rendering scope: Non-finite values — NA, NaN, Inf filtered layer single R warning per layer. Remaining finite points render normally; line/path geoms show visible gap non-finite rows removed. Unsupported geoms — geom type D3 renderer, -panel message appears (e.g., “unsupported geom: polygon”) rather producing silently empty output. R-level errors build — ggplot_build() errors (e.g., incompatible stat/geom combinations), error surfaced R condition D3 rendering attempted.
code: # Non-finite values: filtered with a single warning per layer; # remaining points render with visible gaps df <- data.frame(x = 1:10, y = c(1:4, NA, 6:9, NaN)) (ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +   geom_point() +   geom_line()) |>   gg2d3() # Warning: Removed 2 rows containing non-finite values (geom_point). # The geom_line connects the finite segments and shows a visible gap. # Unsupported geom: in-panel message instead of silent blank # (eval guarded — `map_data("state")` needs the `maps` package which is # not a direct dependency of gg2d3) (ggplot(map_data("state"), aes(long, lat, group = group)) +   geom_polygon()) |>   gg2d3() # Renders an in-panel "unsupported geom: polygon" note rather than empty output.

title: Getting started with gg2d3
text: Pipe ggplot directly: wrap ggplot expression parentheses + resolves |>: (ggplot(...) + geom_point()) |> gg2d3(). Without parens, |> binds tighter + gg2d3() receives last geom — plot. cleaner alternative assign first: p <- ggplot(...) + geom_point(); gg2d3(p). Inspect IR: Use gg2d3:::as_d3_ir(p) see exactly data sent D3. Useful debugging unexpected rendering. Widget sizing: R Markdown, set chunk options fig.width fig.height pass width/height gg2d3(). Performance: large datasets (>10k points), consider using alpha reduce overdraw limit interactivity features need.

text: Enables rectangular brush selection gg2d3 widget. Click drag create selection rectangle; data points inside selection highlighted points outside dimmed. Double-click clear selection.

title: Add brush selection to gg2d3 widget — d3_brush
code: d3_brush(   widget,   direction = c("xy", "x", "y"),   on_brush = NULL,   fill = "#3b82f6",   opacity = 0.15 )

title: Add brush selection to gg2d3 widget — d3_brush
text: widget gg2d3 widget object created gg2d3() direction Character string specifying brush direction. One : "xy" (default): Two-dimensional rectangular brush "x": Horizontal band selection (x-axis ) "y": Vertical band selection (y-axis ) on_brush Optional JavaScript callback string. Receives selected data array. Function signature: function(selectedData) { ... } fill Brush overlay fill color. Default "#3b82f6" (light blue). opacity Numeric opacity value (0-1) non-selected elements. Default 0.15 (heavily dimmed). Selected elements always opacity 1.0.

title: Add brush selection to gg2d3 widget — d3_brush
text: Modified gg2d3 widget brush selection enabled. Returns widget enable pipe chaining.

title: Add brush selection to gg2d3 widget — d3_brush
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(ggplot2) p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, wt)) + geom_point()  # Basic brush selection gg2d3(p) |> d3_brush()  # Horizontal brush only gg2d3(p) |> d3_brush(direction = "x")  # Custom styling gg2d3(p) |> d3_brush(fill = "#ff0000", opacity = 0.3)  # Combine with tooltips gg2d3(p) |> d3_tooltip() |> d3_brush() } # }

what: Add hover effects to gg2d3 widget — d3_hover
title: Add hover effects to gg2d3 widget — d3_hover
text: Enables hover highlighting gg2d3 widget. hovering element, elements dimmed (reduced opacity) hovered element can optionally receive highlight stroke.

title: Add hover effects to gg2d3 widget — d3_hover
code: d3_hover(widget, opacity = 0.3, stroke = NULL, stroke_width = NULL)

title: Add hover effects to gg2d3 widget — d3_hover
text: widget gg2d3 widget object created gg2d3() opacity Numeric opacity value (0-1) non-hovered elements. Default 0.3, strongly dims elements hovered one stands . hovered element always opacity 1.0. stroke Optional stroke color hovered element (e.g., "black", "#ff0000"). NULL, highlight stroke added. stroke_width Optional stroke width pixels hovered element. used stroke provided. Default NULL.

title: Add hover effects to gg2d3 widget — d3_hover
text: Modified gg2d3 widget hover effects enabled. Returns widget enable pipe chaining.

title: Add hover effects to gg2d3 widget — d3_hover
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(ggplot2) p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, wt)) + geom_point()  # Basic hover with default dimming gg2d3(p) |> d3_hover()  # Custom opacity gg2d3(p) |> d3_hover(opacity = 0.3)  # Add highlight stroke gg2d3(p) |> d3_hover(stroke = "red", stroke_width = 2)  # Combine with tooltips gg2d3(p) |> d3_tooltip() |> d3_hover(opacity = 0.5) } # }

what: Add tooltips to gg2d3 widget — d3_tooltip
title: Add tooltips to gg2d3 widget — d3_tooltip
text: Enables interactive tooltips hover gg2d3 widget. Tooltips display data values associated visual element (points, bars, etc.).

title: Add tooltips to gg2d3 widget — d3_tooltip
code: d3_tooltip(widget, fields = NULL, formatter = NULL)

title: Add tooltips to gg2d3 widget — d3_tooltip
text: widget gg2d3 widget object created gg2d3() fields Character vector field names display tooltip. Accepts either original data variable names (e.g. "wt", "mpg") internal aesthetic keys (e.g. "x", "y", "colour"). Variable names resolved via plot's aesthetic mapping; mapped expressions like factor(cyl) can addressed aesthetic key. NULL (default), shows aesthetics except internal fields (starting underscore internal keys like PANEL, group, etc.) formatter Optional JavaScript function string custom value formatting. Function signature: function(field, value) { return formatted_string; }

title: Add tooltips to gg2d3 widget — d3_tooltip
text: Modified gg2d3 widget tooltip interactivity enabled. Returns widget enable pipe chaining.

title: Add tooltips to gg2d3 widget — d3_tooltip
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(ggplot2) p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, wt)) + geom_point()  # Basic tooltip with all fields gg2d3(p) |> d3_tooltip()  # Show only specific fields gg2d3(p) |> d3_tooltip(fields = c("mpg", "wt"))  # Custom formatter gg2d3(p) |> d3_tooltip(   formatter = "if (field === 'mpg') return field + ': ' + value + ' mpg'; return field + ': ' + value;" ) } # }

what: Add zoom and pan to gg2d3 widget — d3_zoom
title: Add zoom and pan to gg2d3 widget — d3_zoom
text: Enables mouse-wheel zoom click-drag pan gg2d3 widget. Users can zoom /mouse wheel, pan dragging, double-click reset original view.

title: Add zoom and pan to gg2d3 widget — d3_zoom
code: d3_zoom(widget, scale_extent = c(1, 8), direction = c("both", "x", "y"))

title: Add zoom and pan to gg2d3 widget — d3_zoom
text: widget gg2d3 widget object created gg2d3() scale_extent Numeric vector length 2 specifying minimum maximum zoom scale factors. Default c(1, 8), allowing 8x zoom. minimum value must >= 1 (zoom beyond original view). direction Character string specifying axes zoom. Options : "" Zoom x y axes (default) "x" Zoom x-axis (horizontal zoom) "y" Zoom y-axis (vertical zoom)

title: Add zoom and pan to gg2d3 widget — d3_zoom
text: Modified gg2d3 widget zoom interactivity enabled. Returns widget enable pipe chaining.

title: Add zoom and pan to gg2d3 widget — d3_zoom
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(ggplot2) p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, wt)) + geom_point()  # Basic zoom (both axes) gg2d3(p) |> d3_zoom()  # Horizontal zoom only gg2d3(p) |> d3_zoom(direction = "x")  # Custom zoom range (1x to 16x) gg2d3(p) |> d3_zoom(scale_extent = c(1, 16))  # Combine with tooltips gg2d3(p) |> d3_tooltip() |> d3_zoom() } # }

title: gg2d3 (development version)
text: Specialized Geoms: Added support geom_dotplot, geom_rug, geom_errorbar, geom_linerange, geom_pointrange. API Polish: Standardized interactivity attachment optimized rendering performance state updates.

title: gg2d3 (development version)
text: Non-Cartesian Systems: Full support coord_polar, including specialized radial/circular axes pie/coxcomb charts. Advanced Stats: High-fidelity rendering geom_density complex geom_smooth (loess, gam).

title: gg2d3 (development version)
text: Theme Parity: Implemented deep theme inheritance support complex element styling (margins, justifications, rotation). Reference Geoms: Added geom_hline, geom_vline, geom_abline robust clipping.

title: gg2d3 (development version)
text: Advanced Facets: Support hierarchical facet headers multiple nesting variables. Custom Interactivity: New R API d3_handlers injecting custom JS logic Shiny synchronization.

title: gg2d3 (development version)
text: Smooth Transitions: Object-constant enter/update/exit animations marks axes. Scale Parity: Enhanced support custom breaks, minor breaks, expansion, OOB logic.

title: gg2d3 (development version)
text: MVP Release: Core support 15 basic geoms, faceting, pipe-based interactivity API (tooltip, zoom, brush, crosstalk).
